name: Agent editor Evals tab renders the case set, its per-case results and the never-run state
description: Opens the seeded Security Reviewer and switches to its Evals tab, guarding the same class of defect the Context-tab flow (11) pinned: the tab button reaching the URL is not proof the panel actually rendered, since a broken `?tab=` whitelist still updates the URL and falls back silently. SPEC-04 (AC-59) removed the run history from this surface, so the case-set heading alone no longer distinguishes it from the SPEC-03 build — the final steps instead assert on copy only SPEC-04 introduces: a case's own expected/returned finding count line (AC-53) and the never-run statement of the seeded case with no severity/category/latest_result yet (AC-54).
